Threshold Harvest Control Rule

Source: R/model_projection.R
hcr_threshold.Rd

The target F above the trigger biomass brp, no fishing below alpha times it, and a straight ramp between. Status is compared on its plain numbers through ad_value, so the rule can run inside the model despite its if. The model keeps the side of the comparison that was true when it was built, and fit_model builds it at the estimates, so that side is the estimated stock's.

Usage

hcr_threshold(x, frp, brp, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

x

Spawning biomass the rule reads.

frp

Fishing mortality reference point.

brp

Biomass reference point.

alpha

Share of brp below which F is zero. Default 0.05.

Value

The F to apply. Inside the model it still depends on x and frp, so sdreport accounts for their uncertainty.

See also

Other Reference Points and Projections: Do_Population_Projection(), Get_Reference_Point_Uncertainty(), Get_Reference_Points(), Setup_Mod_Projection(), catch_cap(), catch_stability(), get_key_quants()

Examples

hcr_threshold(x = 80, frp = 0.1, brp = 100) # on the ramp: 0.1 * (0.8 - 0.05) / 0.95
#> [1] 0.07894737
